quotes.text: Verily, with hardship comes ease.

islamic.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

quotes.text: And He found you lost and guided you.

islamic.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ

quotes.text: And speak to people with goodness.

islamic.arabic: وَقُولُوا لِلنَّاسِ حُسْنًا

quotes.text: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.

islamic.arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ

quotes.text: And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.

islamic.arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ

quotes.text: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.

islamic.arabic: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِينَ

quotes.text: Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves.

islamic.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ

quotes.text: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

islamic.arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ

quotes.text: My mercy encompasses all things.

islamic.arabic: وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ

quotes.text: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided.

islamic.arabic: وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا

quotes.text: Actions are but by intention, and every man shall have only that which he intended.

islamic.arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى

quotes.text: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

islamic.arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

quotes.text: The strong man is not the good wrestler; the strong man is only he who controls himself when he is angry.

islamic.arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ

quotes.text: Take benefit of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your sickness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before your preoccupation, and your life before your death.

islamic.arabic: اغْتَنِمْ خَمْسًا قَبْلَ خَمْسٍ

quotes.text: Allah is beautiful and He loves beauty.

islamic.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَمِيلٌ يُحِبُّ الْجَمَالَ

quotes.text: Kindness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it, and it is not removed from anything except that it blemishes it.

islamic.arabic: إِنَّ الرِّفْقَ لاَ يَكُونُ فِي شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ زَانَهُ وَلاَ يُنْزَعُ مِنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ شَانَهُ

quotes.text: The best of you are those who have the best character.

islamic.arabic: إِنَّ خِيَارَكُمْ أَحْسَنُكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا

quotes.text: A good word is a form of charity.

islamic.arabic: وَالْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ

quotes.text: Speak good or remain silent.

islamic.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ

quotes.text: Richness does not lie in an abundance of worldly goods, but true richness is the contentment of the soul.

islamic.arabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ

quotes.text: The greatest truth is honesty, and the greatest falsehood is treachery.

islamic.arabic: فَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ أَمَانَةٌ، وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ خِيَانَةٌ

quotes.text: He who fears to weep should learn to be kind to those who weep.

islamic.arabic: ارحموا من في الأرض يرحمكم من في السماء

quotes.text: Without knowledge, action is useless; and knowledge without action is futile.
Good actions protect one against the perils of misfortune.
Do not look down upon any Muslim, for even the least among Muslims is great in the sight of Allah.
Hold yourselves to account before you are held to account, and weigh your deeds before they are weighed for you.

islamic.arabic: حَاسِبُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحَاسَبُوا، وَزِنُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُوزَنُوا

quotes.text: Since when have you enslaved the people when their mothers gave birth to them free?

islamic.arabic: مَتَى اسْتَعْبَدْتُمُ النَّاسَ وَقَدْ وَلَدَتْهُمْ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ أَحْرَارًا؟

quotes.text: We were the most humiliated people, but Allah honoured us with Islam. If we ever seek honour from other than what Allah has honoured us with, Allah will humiliate us.

islamic.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا أَذَلَّ قَوْمٍ، فَأَعَزَّنَا اللَّهُ بِالإِسْلامِ

quotes.text: May Allah have mercy upon the person who points out my faults to me.

islamic.arabic: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ امْرَأً أَهْدَى إِلَيَّ عُيُوبِي

quotes.text: Patience is a pillar of faith, just as the head is to the body.
The tongue is like a lion; if you let it loose, it will wound someone.

islamic.arabic: اللِّسَانُ سَبُعٌ إِنْ خُلِّيَ عَنْهُ عَقَرَ

quotes.text: People are of two types: either your brother in faith, or your equal in humanity.

islamic.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ صِنْفَانِ: إِمَّا أَخٌ لَكَ فِي الدِّينِ، أَوْ نَظِيرٌ لَكَ فِي الْخَلْقِ

quotes.text: Do not feel ashamed of giving little, for being deprived is even less.

islamic.arabic: لاَ تَسْتَحِ مِنْ إِعْطَاءِ الْقَلِيلِ، فَإِنَّ الْحِرْمَانَ أَقَلُّ مِنْهُ

quotes.text: Opportunity passes away like the clouds; therefore, make use of good opportunities.

islamic.arabic: الْفُرْصَةُ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ فَانْتَهِزُوا فُرَصَ الْخَيْرِ

quotes.text: A man's worth is in proportion to the value he places on knowledge and wisdom.

islamic.arabic: قِيمَةُ كُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا يُحْسِنُهُ

quotes.text: Knowledge without action is wastefulness and action without knowledge is foolishness.

islamic.arabic: العِلْمُ بِلَا عَمَلٍ جُنُونٌ، وَالعَمَلُ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ لَا يَكُونُ

quotes.text: To get what you love, you must first be patient with what you dislike.
The tongue is very small and light, but its consequences are immense and grave.
Never have I dealt with anything more difficult than my own soul.
Desires make slaves out of kings and patience makes kings out of slaves.
Past and future resemble each other more than water resembles water.

islamic.arabic: الماضي أشبه بالآتي من الماء بالماء

quotes.text: Throughout history, cities arise when men combine to help each other.
The vanquished always seeks to imitate the victor in his characteristics, his dress, and all his ways.

islamic.arabic: المغلوب مولع أبدا بالاقتداء بالغالب

quotes.text: He who finds a new path is a pathfinder, even if the trail is overgrown.
The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
Do not be satisfied with the stories that come before you. Unfold your own myth.
Raise your words, not voice. It is rain that grows flowers, not thunder.
Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
Silence is the language of God, all else is poor translation.
My heart is at ease knowing that what was meant for me will never miss me, and what misses me was never meant for me.

islamic.arabic: توكلت في رزقي على الله خالقي

quotes.text: Time is like a sword: if you do not cut it, it will cut you.

islamic.arabic: الوقت كالسيف إن لم تقطعه قطعك

quotes.text: The more knowledge I acquire, the more I realize my ignorance.

islamic.arabic: كلما أدبني الدهر أراني نقص عقلي

quotes.text: If you cannot bear the fatigue of learning, you will bear the humiliation of ignorance for life.
You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
When you arise in the morning think of what a privilege it is to be alive: to think, to enjoy, to love.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together, but do so with all your heart.
Never let the future disturb you. You will meet it, if you have to, with the same weapons of reason which today arm you against the present.
The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury.
Look back over the past, with its changing empires that rose and fell, and you can foresee the future too.
Dwell on the beauty of life. Watch the stars, and see yourself running with them.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
Life is like a play: it's not the length, but the excellence of the acting that matters.
If a man knows not to which port he sails, no wind is favorable.
Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end.
Men are disturbed not by things, but by the view which they take of them.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has.
Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it.
It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
To find yourself, think for yourself.
Be kind, for everyone you meet is fighting a hard battle.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
It is the mark of an educated mind to be able to entertain a thought without accepting it.
Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Silence is a source of great strength.
He who knows that enough is enough will always have enough.
When you are content to be simply yourself and don't compare or compete, everyone will respect you.
Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose our response.
Those who have a 'why' to live, can bear with almost any 'how'.
When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of human freedoms - to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances.
Life is never made unbearable by circumstances, but only by lack of meaning and purpose.
You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
Small habits don't add up. They compound.
Standardize before you optimize. You can't improve a habit that doesn't exist.
The greatest threat to success is not failure but boredom. We get bored with habits because they stop delighting us.
Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
Simple can be harder than complex: You have to work hard to get your thinking clean to make it simple.
Deciding what not to do is as important as deciding what to do.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle.
Clarity about what matters provides clarity about what does not.
If you don't produce, you won't thrive - no matter how skilled or talented you are.
Effort is not enough. You must also cultivate focus.
To produce at your peak level you need to work for extended periods with full concentration on a single task free from distraction.
An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
Energy and persistence conquer all things.
Lost time is never found again.
Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
And He is with you wherever you are.

islamic.arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ

quotes.text: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

islamic.arabic: ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ

quotes.text: Indeed, what is to come will be better for you than what has gone by.

islamic.arabic: وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ الْأُولَىٰ

quotes.text: And put your trust in the Living who does not die.

islamic.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ

quotes.text: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.

islamic.arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا

quotes.text: Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive.

islamic.arabic: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ

quotes.text: And never say of anything, 'Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,' except [when adding], 'If Allah wills.'

islamic.arabic: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَيْءٍ إِنِّي فَاعِلٌ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ

quotes.text: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out.

islamic.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا

quotes.text: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

islamic.arabic: وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

quotes.text: Is not Allah sufficient for His servant?

islamic.arabic: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ

quotes.text: The most beloved of deeds to Allah are those that are most consistent, even if they are small.

islamic.arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ

quotes.text: He who is not merciful to others will not be treated with mercy.

islamic.arabic: مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ لاَ يُرْحَمُ

quotes.text: Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.

islamic.arabic: طَلَبُ الْعِلْمِ فَرِيضَةٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ

quotes.text: The upper hand is better than the lower hand.

islamic.arabic: الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى

quotes.text: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not repel.

islamic.arabic: يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا

quotes.text: Whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make easy for him the path to Paradise.

islamic.arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ

quotes.text: Part of someone's being a good Muslim is leaving alone that which does not concern him.

islamic.arabic: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلاَمِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لاَ يَعْنِيهِ

quotes.text: Fear Allah wherever you may be, follow up a bad deed with a good deed which will wipe it out, and behave well towards the people.

islamic.arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهِ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ

quotes.text: Be not deceived by the flattery of men.
If you expect the blessings of God, be kind to His people.
Cooperate with each other in righteousness and piety.
Patience half of faith, and certainty is the whole of it.
Watch your steps lest you slip, for slipping in truth is dangerous.
No amount of guilt can change the past, and no amount of worrying can change the future.
Sit with those who constantly repent, for they have the softest hearts.
Do not be fooled by one who recites the Quran; rather look at him who returns trust and refrains from dishonour.
Let not your love be an obsession, nor your hatred a destruction.

islamic.arabic: لا يَكُنْ حُبُّكَ كَلَفًا، وَلا بُغْضُكَ تَلَفًا

quotes.text: He who keeps his secret keeps his power.
Silence is the best reply to a fool.
He who has no patience has no faith.

islamic.arabic: لا إِيمَانَ لِمَنْ لا صَبْرَ لَهُ

quotes.text: Two things define you: your patience when you have nothing and your attitude when you have everything.
The disease of the heart is worse than the disease of the body.
A wise man thinks before he speaks, while a fool speaks then thinks.
Wealth without wisdom is like water in a sieve.
Forgiveness is the best triumph.

islamic.arabic: العَفْوُ أَحْسَنُ الِانْتِصَارِ

quotes.text: The real solitude is to be in the midst of people without being entangled in their idle talk.
Half of disbelief in the world is caused by people who make religion difficult.
To know the disease of the heart is the first step towards healing.
Envy consumes virtue as fire consumes dry wood.
If words come from the heart, they will enter the heart, but if they come from the tongue, they will not pass beyond the ears.
Government is an institution which prevents injustice other than such as it commits itself.
Businesses owned by responsible and organized merchants eventually surpass those built on reckless luck.
Man is a child of customs, not of his ancestors.
Hard times create strong men. Strong men create easy times. Easy times create weak men. Weak men create hard times.
Stop acting so small. You are the universe in ecstatic motion.
What you seek is seeking you.
Let yourself be silently drawn by the strange pull of what you really love. It will not lead you astray.
Wear gratitude like a cloak and it will feed every corner of your life.
Set your life on fire. Seek those who fan your flames.
Whoever advises his brother privately has counseled him and honored him, but whoever advises him publicly has humiliated him.

islamic.arabic: مَنْ وَعَظَ أَخَاهُ سِرًّا فَقَدْ نَصَحَهُ وَزَانَهُ

quotes.text: If you speak when angry, you will make the best speech you will ever regret.
Travel! For in traveling there are five benefits: relief from worry, gaining a livelihood, acquiring knowledge, learning etiquette, and the companionship of noble people.
I love the righteous even if I am not among them, so that perhaps I may obtain their intercession.

islamic.arabic: أُحِبُّ الصَّالِحِينَ وَلَسْتُ مِنْهُمْ

quotes.text: It never ceases to amaze me: we all love ourselves more than other people, but care more about their opinion than our own.
Confine yourself to the present.
Receive without conceit, release without struggle.
Be tolerant with others and strict with yourself.
The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.
He who is brave is free.
Associate with people who are likely to improve you.
To wish to be well is a part of becoming well.
No tree becomes rooted and sturdy unless many a wind assails it.
A gift consists not in what is done or given, but in the intention of the giver.
Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
Only the educated are free.
If anyone tells you that a certain person speaks ill of you, do not make excuses, but reply: 'He must have been ignorant of my other faults, else he would not have mentioned these alone.'
Freedom is the only worthy goal in life. It is won by disregarding things that lie beyond our control.
Attach yourself to what is spiritually superior, regardless of what other people think or do.
Wonder is the beginning of wisdom.
Contentment is natural wealth, luxury is artificial poverty.
He who is not contented with what he has, would not be contented with what he would like to have.
Employ your time in improving yourself by other men's writings so that you shall come easily by what others have labored hard for.
Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
Hope is a waking dream.

source.title: Diogenes Laertius, Lives of Eminent Philosophers
source.reference: Diogenes Laertius, Lives of Eminent Philosophers

quotes.text: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
The roots of education are bitter, but the fruit is sweet.
Mastering others is strength. Mastering yourself is true power.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner.
Simplicity, patience, compassion. These three are your greatest treasures.
Water is the softest thing, yet it can penetrate mountains and earth. This shows clearly the principle of softness overcoming hardness.
An active life serves the purpose of giving man the opportunity to realize values in creative work.
What is to give light must endure burning.
The salvation of man is through love and in love.
Decisions, not conditions, determine what a person is.
Ultimately, man should not ask what the meaning of his life is, but rather must recognize that it is he who is asked.
You don't have to be the victim of your environment. You can also be the architect of it.
The cost of your good habits is in the present. The cost of your bad habits is in the future.
Missing once is an accident. Missing twice is the start of a new habit.
Be ruthless about your time, but generous with your patience.
Being consistent with small actions leads to remarkable transformations over time.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
I'm as proud of many of the things we haven't done as the things we have done. Innovation is saying no to a thousand things.
Details matter, it's worth waiting to get it right.
Quality is much better than quantity. One home run is much better than two doubles.
If you really look closely, most overnight successes took a long time.
The ability to perform deep work is becoming increasingly rare at exactly the same time it is becoming increasingly valuable in our economy.
Busyness is not productivity. Depth is productivity.
Less mental clutter means more mental horsepower.
Treat your attention with respect.
Leave good work behind you every day.

source.title: So Good They Can't Ignore You
source.reference: So Good They Can't Ignore You

quotes.text: By failing to prepare, you are preparing to fail.
Diligence is the mother of good luck.
Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise.
Well done is better than well said.
He that can have patience can have what he will.
